scope: ten most-declared symbols with disagreeing TU-local declarations

evidence.retail_callees: The linked retail-equivalent ELF shows fn_8011EB04 and fn_80035628 reading through r3, fn_8016B400 consuming r3-r5, fn_801A852C reading the four-byte template through r3 and consuming r4-r6, fn_80201E78 consuming r3-r4 without a result, fn_80201AE4 returning the r13 global in r3, fn_80201B64 reading through r3 and returning in r3, and fn_80204844 consuming r3-r4 and returning the found node in r3.
evidence.matched_definitions: Matching C definitions establish fn_8001D9FC as a one-integer setter, fn_80038464 as a three-argument integer-result getter, and fn_80035628 as a one-pointer integer-result getter.
evidence.call_sites: Every declaration and call was unified. Explicit result casts or captured call results were added where old-style declarations had depended on live r3. The Color spelling preserves the established PPC EABI lowering: the UI caller's four-byte aggregate and the other callers' local pointer typedefs all place the read-only template address in r3 without changing generated code.
